title: IngestRequest
description: A batch of signed TenantEvents submitted to AuditForge POST /v1/events. Each event carries its own detached signature (see ecosystem/auditforge/spec.md, The signing contract).

keyId.description: Identifier of the shared signing key used to sign every event in this batch.

events.description: The signed TenantEvents. Each MUST validate against TenantEvent.schema.json and carry a non-empty signature.
